verdict.rationale: PostHog's own product analytics docs list 'paths' as a first-class insight type built on captured events, so path exploration is a direct, documented capability. The pack gives only a single-line mention, though, with nothing on anchoring paths to a key event or looking before or after it. Missing for 10: documentation of paths starting from or ending at a chosen event, detail on path depth and filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can explore the paths users actually take before or after a key event

citations.quote: Build trends, funnels, retention, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle insights on the events you already send to PostHog
